source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DL400, read 2026-11-24: « ES9039MSPRO of American ESS, built-in MQA hard decoding »; « New 3rd generation XMOS XU-316, PCM support up to 32bit/768kHz,DSD support to DSD512 »; « All inputs except Bluetooth support DSD transmission, coaxial, optical, AES/EBU support DoP64 »; « Qualcomm Bluetooth 5.1 chip supports LDAC 24bit/96kHz , APTX/HD , SBC , AAC ».

facts.chip: ES9039MSPRO (ESS) converting, third-generation XMOS XU-316 as the USB interface, Qualcomm Bluetooth 5.1.

_aes_is_dop_here: « coaxial, optical, AES/EBU support DoP64 » puts AES among the DoP-only inputs, where smsl/d400-mk2 and smsl/do300ex leave it native. Third variant of the same maker's AES behaviour across four models.
